climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A very recent California AVA, established in 2024, in a valley in the foothills of the San Bernardino Mountains. It covers about 57 square miles, and elevation and climate are its distinguishing features.
